{"code": "sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows where revenue is invalid
sales_df = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Check if the drop worked
print("Rows after dropping invalid revenue:", len(sales_df))

# Check for duplicates
print("Duplicate rows:", sales_df.duplicated().sum())

# Check distribution of key variables
print("Channel distribution:")
print(sales_df['channel'].value_counts())

print("Customer segment distribution:")
print(sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check conversion rates by channel
print("Conversion rate by channel:")
conversion_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print(conversion_by_channel)

# Check conversion rates by customer segment
print("Conversion rate by customer segment:")
conversion_by_segment = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()
print(conversion_by_segment)"}
